scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:edge && npm test && npm run test:server && npm run test:edge && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests *.ts *.json index.html docs README.md
scripts.types:edge: wrangler types worker/env.d.ts --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface Env && wrangler types pages-env.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --env-interface PagesEnv --include-runtime false && prettier --write worker/env.d.ts pages-env.d.ts
scripts.build:edge: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --outdir "$PWD/test-results/worker" && wrangler pages functions build --outdir test-results/pages --compatibility-date 2026-10-19 --compatibility-flags nodejs_compat
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:secrets && npm run test:e2e
